sql.value: select a.id, a.name, a.scope, a.api_key_id, k.name as api_key_name, a.metric, a.threshold_percent, a.threshold_value, a.notify_channel, a.notify_target, a.last_triggered_time, a.trigger_count, a.enable_status, a.create_time, a.update_time from ai_quota_alert a left join ai_api_key k on k.id = a.api_key_id where a.is_deleted = 0 #[and a.name like concat('%', :name, '%')] #[and a.scope = :scope] #[and a.metric = :metric] #[and a.api_key_id = :apiKeyId] #[and a.enable_status = :enableStatus] order by a.id desc

select id, name, scope, api_key_id, metric, threshold_percent, threshold_value, notify_channel, notify_target, last_triggered_time, trigger_count, enable_status from ai_quota_alert where is_deleted = 0 and enable_status = 1 #[and (scope = 'global' or api_key_id = :apiKeyId)]
